name: Vesper
title: Shadow Warden
build: Arcane Tankster, adapted for a four-player co-op party
role: The party's front-line tank and thief. In medium armour and a shield she Dashes in, Booming Blades with her Shadow Blade and steps back, so enemies take thunder chasing her. Her psychic hits stack Mental Fatigue, setting up her own Phantasmal Killer and Fear and Alene's Hold Person.
bio: Vesper never knew her parents. The Lower City of Baldur's Gate raised her: its alleys, its rooftops, and the lessons of being a horned girl in a city that crosses the street when it sees one.

By sixteen she was the eldest of the Rats, a handful of orphans who slept in the loft of a burned-out chandlery above the docks. She fed them the way urchins do: lifted purses, emptied lockboxes, and a light touch that never left a trace.

The wards came from a fence's stall. She stole a waterlogged spellbook for the price it would fetch, found it full of abjuration, and kept it instead. Night by night she taught herself to read it: an alarm glyph on the loft's door, a shimmer of force to turn a Flaming Fist cudgel, a blade of shadow for when turning wasn't enough. The kids started calling her their warden. She pretended to hate it.

On the last night, she was on the roof keeping watch when the clouds over the harbour split and something vast slid through them. Tentacles came down into the streets. She remembers shouting for the kids to stay inside, then nothing.
Now she wakes with a worm behind her eyes, on a ship that should not exist, and the Rats are alone in the city. Whatever this is, she's getting back to them.

illithid.intro: Optional. The build works without the tadpole. She stays off the Astral-Touched Tadpole, so no partial-illithid powers or appearance change: these are the regular powers that fit.
illithid.warning: Awakened turns illithid powers into bonus actions, but her bonus action already goes to Cunning Dash in her hit-and-run turn.

powers.why: Illithid powers cost a bonus action instead of an action. You get it by succeeding at the Zaith'isk.

+1d4 psychic on every attack for 10 turns or until combat ends, so each hit adds Mental Fatigue through Braindrain. Turning it on costs her bonus action, even with Awakened, so she skips that turn's Cunning Dash. She takes 1d4 psychic every turn, which forces a concentration check: best when she isn't holding Phantasmal Killer, Fear or Slow.
Taken to unlock Cull the Weak and Psionic Backlash.
Finishes off low-HP enemies, and each kill deals 1–4 psychic damage to every creature nearby. With Braindrain Gloves, that spreads Mental Fatigue across the group.

Cast it before the fight: 10 temporary HP that last until a long rest. When opportunity attacks break it, it bursts, and nearby enemies make a DC 15 INT save or are Stunned for a turn. Mental Fatigue lowers that save, and stunned enemies give her Advantage for Sneak Attack. She can only hold temporary HP from one source, so Vivacious Cloak's would replace it.

A reaction when an enemy within 9 m casts a spell: 1d4 psychic per spell level, which adds Mental Fatigue and can break their concentration. It uses the reaction she'd spend on Shield or Counterspell, so save it for fights against casters.

slots.note: Close call. Sarevok's for single targets and Fear-heavy fights. Balduran when hard hitters, Mind Flayers or stuns focus her: Viconia's shield doesn't stop crits. Holy Lance against crowds of weaker attackers.
Optional: once the amulet never comes off, respec at Withers from CON 14 / WIS 10 to CON 8 / WIS 15 for +2 WIS saves against Hold, Fear and Dominate. Without the amulet she's then on CON 8 HP.
Infusion adds thunder after every Booming Blade. Wear Mental Inhibition in fights where she leads with Phantasmal Killer, Slow or Fear.
Summoned by her Shadow Blade spell. Cast with a 3rd-level slot for 3d8 psychic. Have an ally enchant it with the Drakethroat Glaive.

loadouts.armour_class: Armour of Agility 22 (at DEX 20) + Viconia's Walking Fortress 3 = 25 AC, and Cloak of Displacement gives attackers Disadvantage until she's hit. Helm of Balduran adds 1 when survival matters more. Shield adds +5 when needed.

turn: Cunning Action: Dash toward the target. The Speedy Lightfeet give 3 Lightning Charges.
Booming Blade with Shadow Blade, and add Sneak Attack on the hit.
Use the rest of her movement to back away, so the target has to move to reach her and takes Booming Blade's thunder.

Backing away draws opportunity attacks. Uncanny Dodge halves each hit and, in the current patch, doesn't use up her reaction, so Shield (+5 AC for the round) and Counterspell stay free. The Arcane Ward soaks the rest. Misses trigger Holy Lance Helm and the Adamantine Shield.
An empty Arcane Ward refills to her Wizard level the next time she casts Booming Blade or gains Lightning Charges or Arcane Acuity. It only works at exactly 0 charges.
Can't reach a target? Cast Blade Ward and Dash past enemies instead: resistance plus Uncanny Dodge cuts their physical hits by 75%.
If an opportunity attack would be too dangerous, use Cunning Disengage instead of Dash.

Bombs are a last resort. From level 11, Evasion makes point-blank bombs much safer for her, but not for her friends. Before one, fill her Arcane Ward and boost her saves with Bless, Resistance or Heroism.

From level 11, Evasion means a passed DEX save takes no damage from Alene's Call Lightning or Ice Storm, Pearl's Conjure Barrage, Glyph of Warding, Fireball and most grenades, so friends can aim them at enemies around her. Smokepowder Arrows aren't covered, and the wiki doesn't list Spike Growth, Hunger of Hadar, Cone of Cold, Sunbeam, Insect Plague or Wall of Fire.
start_of_day: Ask the Gloom Stalker for Longstrider: more movement for running in and back out.
Prepare the Wizard spells for her level, then swap freely out of combat.
From level 8, cast Shadow Blade. From level 9, use a 3rd-level slot.
Before a theft: Boon ring, cast Disguise Self, then theft ring and gloves.
Decide whether the Resonance Stone is safe to carry today.
theft: Put on Shapeshifter's Boon Ring, then cast Disguise Self (or use Mask of the Shapeshifter if you swapped at level 11).
Put on Smuggler's Ring and Gloves of Thievery, and from Act 2 Cloak of Cunning Brume. Get Guidance from the Druid, or cast it with the Silver Pendant.
Split from the group and Hide. Keep your friends out of the crime scene.

From Act 2: switch to turn-based mode, Disengage next to the target in Cloak of Cunning Brume, Hide in the fog and pickpocket before it fades after 1 turn. In Act 1, shoot a Darkness arrow next to the target instead.
Steal at least one copy of every Wizard scroll you find.
After a successful pickpocket, leave before the victim notices.

If caught and given a dialogue check, pick Deception. Use Friends after a failed pickpocket, once Guidance doesn't matter any more. On Tactician, casting Friends is itself a crime, so cast it out of sight.
On Tactician, Friends can anger its target when it ends. Leave, camp or fast-travel before the 10 turns run out. Never use Friends on companions.
Caught with no dialogue check: Disengage for fog, or shoot a Darkness arrow for a longer-lasting cloud, then Hide in it and get away.
Next time, use a different disguise: the victim won't recognise her.
If you keep getting caught, slip away instead of escalating.

reactions.name: Sneak Attack
reactions.why: Booming Blade is her only attack on her own turn, so there's no better hit to save it for. It's once per turn, so an opportunity attack on an enemy's turn can still use it. Check in game that it leaves her reaction free.

reactions.name: Sneak Attack (Critical Hit)
reactions.why: The same on a crit, with the dice doubled. Sarevok's helmet makes her crit on 19–20.

reactions.name: Shield
reactions.why: Spend the slot only when +5 AC changes the result. It gives no Arcane Ward charges.

reactions.name: Counterspell
reactions.why: Skip harmless casts. It always gives 3 Arcane Ward charges.

reactions.name: Hellish Rebuke
reactions.why: Low priority: weak with her Charisma.

reactions.name: Uncanny Dodge
reactions.why: Halves each hit from a different attacker. In the current patch it needs her reaction free but doesn't use it up, so Shield and Counterspell stay available.

reactions.name: Rebuke of the Mighty (Viconia's)
reactions.why: Never let it take the reaction you need for Shield or Counterspell.

mage_hand: Scout dangerous rooms while it's invisible. It turns visible when it acts and goes invisible again on a short rest.
Drop a potion for the Hand to throw to an ally.
Stand it next to an enemy to count as the ally Sneak Attack needs.
Turn off lights so targets are obscured, which gives her Shadow Blade Advantage.
Before combat, throw or shove enemies off ledges or into chasms. Give the Hand a Hill Giant Strength elixir first so the throw succeeds.
Cast Mage Armour and Longstrider on the Hand to keep it alive and moving.
